notes.subject: לנפשי
notes.rationale: נפש em i bel, laip, win bilong bodi — 'bel bilong mi' i klostu, i no 'soul'.

notes.subject: יגורו
notes.rationale: גור hia — 'ol i kampo klostu' o 'ol i singaut nogut long mi'; ol tanim tok i no wankain.

notes.subject: David i tok long Yahwe
notes.rationale: Nem Yahwe i stap long laspela tok — tok i go stret long em.

translation: Long wanem, lukim, ol i hait pastaim bilong ketchim bel bilong mi; ol strongpela man ol i sanapn klostu long mi — i no bilong pasin bilong brukim lo bilong mi, na i no bilong sin bilong mi, Yahwe.
